Specification: This specification defines a very small TLA+ module with one constant and one operator. The operator Bar takes an argument y and constructs a two-element tuple containing the module constant C and the argument y. The module does not define any state variables, actions, temporal behavior, fault model, or verification properties; it is purely a structural value definition.
